_comment: This repo's `./dev.sh check`, in parts, run by devtools/parts.py (setup's `parts` component renders it from tools/checks' runner; its header is the format). Every part reads the whole repo ('.'); a test part does not read the other test modules or TODO.md. A part whose result depends on what no files list can name (a sibling tool, the workspace top, its recipes) says `always` and is never skipped by --resume. tests/test_parts.py holds this file to the test modules (one part per tests/test_*.py) and to devtools/check.py's gates (one part each), both ways.

parts.name: test.datarepo
parts.always: runs tools/checks' stores-exported, a sibling repo

parts.name: test.direction
parts.always: runs tools/checks' no-roster, a sibling repo

parts.name: test.docs
parts.always: reads PLAN-usage-reporting.md at the workspace top

parts.name: test.gate_todo
parts.always: runs the real tools/todo CLI and reads its vocab.json, a sibling repo

parts.name: test.questions
parts.always: runs the workspace's hits reader (outside this repo) against this CLI

parts.name: hooks
parts.always: test-prefer-recipes.sh and test-troubleshooting.sh read the workspace's recipes

parts.name: bars
parts.always: a service row's verb is read from that sibling repo's cli.json

parts.name: shared
parts.always: `checks run .` reads tools/hooks, the workspace top and the user's settings
